# Stellio

> Stellio (v0.6.9) is a 3D file library management application for 3D printing: indexing of local/SMB/NFS folders, thumbnails and 3D viewer, sending to slicers, printer monitoring (Bambu, Elegoo, Creality, FlashForge, Klipper/Moonraker), filament inventory (Spoolman, manual, TigerTag), model downloads (Printables, MakerWorld, Thingiverse, Nexprint), print history, costs/PDF quotes, local AI diagnostics (Ollama). Flask backend (a single Python file; announced license AGPL v3, see the note on `LICENSE` below), vanilla HTML/JS/CSS frontend with no build step, SQLite data. Packaged as a desktop app (pywebview + PyInstaller) or as a headless server (Raspberry Pi/Linux), with an Android companion app (APK).

Important notes for an agent / LLM:
- The project is monolithic: `main.py` (~22,000 lines), `script.js` (~18,300 lines), `index.html` (~4,000 lines), `style.css` (~8,000 lines). Consult `CODEMAP.md` to locate a function or a route by line number before reading these files in full.
- No frontend framework: a single page (SPA) where the `<div class="page" id="page-*">` elements are shown/hidden; modals have the id `modal-*`.
- All UI strings go through i18n (`data-i18n` / `I18N.t`), 8 languages, 1,793 keys each, `fr` = reference/fallback language. Any new string must be added to all 8 files.
- Code comments and log messages are in French.
- JSON REST API under `/api/*`, Flask session (cookie) + CSRF protection; read-only "guest" role.
- Public repository: https://github.com/stellio-app/stellio (branch `main`, commit "V 0.6.9", 84 files, no tests folder, `bin/` ignored by `.gitignore`, no Android sources: only the APK is versioned). The line numbers in `CODEMAP.md` match this commit.
- ⚠️ License: the README, its translations and the badge announce **AGPL v3**, but the provided `LICENSE` file is the text of the **GPL v3** (and the "About" window displays "All rights reserved"). To be settled before citing a license.
- User data: `~/.stellio` (Linux/macOS) or `%APPDATA%\Stellio` (Windows), overridable via `STELLIO_DATA_DIR`. Database: `stellio.db`; settings: `app_settings.json`.
- Useful environment variables: `STELLIO_HEADLESS`, `STELLIO_PORT` (default 5000), `STELLIO_SERVER_URL`, `STELLIO_START_MINIMIZED`, `STELLIO_DATA_DIR`, `STELLIO_ALLOWED_SOURCE_TYPES`.

## Documentation

- [CODEMAP.md](CODEMAP.md): detailed code map (main.py sections, API routes by domain, SQLite tables, JS functions by area, HTML pages/modals, i18n)

## Build, tests and distribution

- [check_deps.py](check_deps.py): checks/repairs dependencies (`--fix`, `--telegram`); `main.py` imports it and keeps a fallback list — any new dependency goes into `requirements.txt`, `check_deps.REQUIRED_MODULES` and this fallback list
- [requirements.txt](requirements.txt): pip dependencies (Linux: additionally `pywebview[gtk]` and GTK/WebKit system packages)
- [conftest.py](conftest.py): pytest config, stubs for `trimesh`/`pyrender`/`pymeshfix`/`smbclient`/`rarfile`, temporary `STELLIO_DATA_DIR`
- [stellio-setup.iss](stellio-setup.iss): Inno Setup Windows installer (installs the PyInstaller output `dist\Stellio`, VC++ Redist and WebView2 when needed, updates via `.zip` patch)
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): full text of the GNU GPL v3 (June 29, 2007) — inconsistent with the AGPL v3 announced everywhere else
- [CODE_SIGNING_POLICY.md](CODE_SIGNING_POLICY.md): code signing policy (EN) — EV/OV certificate, key on HSM/service (SignPath cited), Author/Reviewer/Approver roles, update integrity, response in case of compromise
- [entitlements.plist](entitlements.plist): macOS signing entitlements
- [sw.js](sw.js): PWA service worker (API never cached, assets cache-first)
- [launcher.py](launcher.py): entry point compiled by PyInstaller; launches `app/main.py` (copied next to it, replaceable by the `.zip` patches) via `runpy` with `run_name="stellio_main"`
- [.github/workflows/build-and-sign.yml](.github/workflows/build-and-sign.yml): GitHub Actions — Windows build (+ Inno Setup installer + `.zip` patch), macOS arm64/x86_64 (.dmg), Linux (AppImage), then draft release; only publishes if `CURRENT_VERSION` in `main.py` changes
- [install-pi.sh](install-pi.sh): Raspberry Pi/Linux installer (venv + `stellio` systemd service, headless mode)
- [stellio_manager.bat](stellio_manager.bat): Windows development menu (creates/uses `venv`, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, `check_deps.py --fix`, launches `main.py` in test or DEBUG mode, or the git-ignored `test/` folder)
- [.gitignore](.gitignore): ignores `python/`, `venv/`, `bin/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `test/`, `*.db`, `*.log`, certificates (`*.p12`, `*.pfx`, `*.pem`), `StellioCompanion/` (local Android project)
- [apk/stellio.apk](apk/stellio.apk): Android companion app (`com.stellioapp.companion`, WebView + QR scan + photo), sources not provided
- [worker.py](worker.py): 3MF worker skeleton, currently unused by `main.py`
- [README.md](README.md): public presentation, installation (Windows, Raspberry Pi/Linux), supported printers, keyboard shortcuts

## Backend

- [main.py](main.py): Flask server + all business logic (auth, sources, scanning, thumbnails, downloads, slicers, printers, filament, reports, AI, remote access, updates). Entry point at line ~21810 (`if __name__ in ('__main__', 'stellio_main')`), waitress server on 0.0.0.0, pywebview window except in headless mode.

## Frontend

- [index.html](index.html): SPA structure (sidebar, 14 `page-*` pages, ~50 `modal-*` modals), loads Three.js r128 (3D viewer), Font Awesome and Material Design Icons locally (`assets/vendor/`)
- [script.js](script.js): all client logic (I18N, auth, library, dashboard, 3D viewer, slicers, printers, filament/Spoolman, SOS Print, history, settings, Ctrl+K palette)
- [style.css](style.css): dark/light theme via CSS variables (`--accent`, `--bg-*`), per-manufacturer accent (`data-fabricant="bambu|prusa|voron|creality"`), gallery/details views

## Assets

- [assets/logo-nom-stellio.ico](assets/logo-nom-stellio.ico): app icon (multi-size ICO, 16 to 256 px); used by the Inno Setup installer, PyInstaller (Windows) and, once converted, by the macOS (.icns) and AppImage builds
- [assets/tigertag-logo.svg](assets/tigertag-logo.svg): TigerTag logo (monochrome black SVG, 92×92 pt) displayed in the TigerTag banner of the filament inventory

- [assets/](assets/): `logo-stellio.png` (favicon, sidebar), `nom-stellio.png` (sidebar logotype), `logo-nom-stellio.png` (login screen, PDF reports), `tigertag-logo.png` (not referenced), `vendor/` (Font Awesome, Inter, Material Design Icons, Three.js r128 + loaders, all loaded locally by `index.html`); `logo-stellio - Copie.png` is an unused duplicate (ICO renamed to .png)
- README screenshots at the root: `library.png`, `monitoring.png`, `slicer.png`, `nesting.png` (1920 px)

## Data and translations

- [languages/fr.json](languages/fr.json): reference language (flat `section.key` keys + `__dir`, `__name`, `__native` metadata); same for `en`, `de`, `es`, `it`, `ja`, `pt`, `zh`
- [languages/changelog.json](languages/changelog.json): release notes per language (`[{version, items:{fr:[...], en:[...], ...}}]`), displayed in "What's new"
- [languages/useful_links.json](languages/useful_links.json): default useful links (groups: general shops, manufacturer shops, 3D models, resources); optional `search_url` with `{q}` and `vendors`
- [languages/filament_shops.json](languages/filament_shops.json): shops offered by a spool's "Buy" button (Atome3D, Rainbow3D, Amazon, Bambu Lab), search URL with `{q}`

## User documentation

- [README.md](README.md): public presentation (EN); translations in `docs/readme/README.{fr,de,es,it,pt,ja,zh}.md`
- [docs/privacy/PRIVACY.md](docs/privacy/PRIVACY.md): "local-first" privacy policy; translations `PRIVACY.{fr,de,es,it,pt,ja,zh}.md`

## Optional

- External integrations: Printables, MakerWorld, Thingiverse, Nexprint (model downloads; Nexprint = Elegoo's library, login through a window of the official site or the `auth_token` cookie); Spoolman and TigerTag (filament); Ollama (local AI, can be disabled); ntfy/Telegram/Discord/webhook (push notifications); Cloudflare Tunnel (`cloudflared`) or custom address (remote access).
- Supported printers: Bambu Lab (MQTT), Creality (WebSocket), FlashForge, Elegoo (SDCP, CC2), Klipper/Moonraker, OctoPrint, PrusaLink.
- Detected slicers: Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, SuperSlicer, Cura, Creality Print, Elegoo Slicer, Anycubic Slicer, Lychee (time/weight estimation via G-code).
